The only unproved material is outside the stated three-sparse \(\mathbb Z_4^d\) scope.

value.rationale: The theorem turns a small-group numerical uncertainty picture into a uniform structural law for every dimension \(d\): a three-sparse signal is governed entirely by the subgroup generated by its support differences, and only four local geometries occur. This gives exact spectra for every prescribed support, not merely a minimum or a finite table, and isolates the mechanism that can be reused for other exponent-four groups and higher sparse strata.
